items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I had worked with Dizzy. He had come to Barnet 's band... I knew Diz.

ctx.x: Do you know that Dizzy Gillespie won't have a drummer unless he has that?
Yes, Dizzy was with Charlie Barnet for awhile. He came from Cab's band.
All of the great jazz instrumentalists nowadays buy their own Chinese cymbals so that you have --
